area: the daily challenge and Hangar training, the game-list gate, the /bug-ledger skill
summary: TrainingGames.asset is now empty: all four of its training games (Block Bandit, Dolphin Darts, Maze Run, Slip and Stride) led to scenes deleted on 2026-10-13 and are moved to Games/_Archive. So the daily challenge reports itself unavailable instead of loading a missing scene, and HangarScreen.DisplayTrainingModal opens only for a hull with two training games. Which live games the daily challenge should offer is your call. Tooling: check_gamelist_scenes.py now runs on Windows (forward-slash paths) and fails on any live asset that points at a dead archived asset; /bug-ledger section 6 has the sweep read phone sessions and run that check.
why: A build's console showed "Scene 'MinigameMazeRun' couldn't be loaded" and the Bug Ledger had no record of it.
